problem_type: Repeated local uploads create duplicate project assets
symptom: Importing the same local file twice shows duplicate library entries
direct_cause: Both byte and native import writers allocate a unique filename on every invocation
class_root: The shared upload persistence boundary lacks project-scoped content identity
affected_population: Repeated and concurrent local media uploads via bytes and native file paths
internal_only_reason: Internal project upload identity uses existing Node SHA256 and filesystem primitives; no external format changes.
invariants: Equal upload bytes within one project resolve to the same stored URL
Different bytes and different projects retain distinct identity
Generated outputs and captures keep their existing persistence semantics
Parsed sidecars must be JSON records before their fields are consumed
Stored bytes are verified against size/mtime/ctime hash cache in both legacy and new content directories; changed files and invalid metadata are never overwritten
generality_proof: Bytes and native uploads await the same project/hash single-flight boundary. Legacy same-size uploads use streamed SHA256 and their original URLs; new uploads use a content directory. The existing renderer URL merge preserves intentional canvas reuse.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Hash and publish native copies through the same content identity

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Byte imports delegate upload persistence after media validation
Native copies delegate upload persistence after media validation
Generated materialization has its own identity and is unchanged

recurrence.reason: Every new import invocation previously allocated another path
same_class_scan: assetUploadApi.ts importNativeFile and importFile converge on projectAssetStore
importAudioToLibrary.ts and assetImportAdapter.ts both use assetUploadApi
useAssetPool.ts composeAssetPoolSources deduplicates stored render URLs

prevention.invariant: One stored URL for equal upload bytes in a project
prevention.failure_mode: Copy or publication errors propagate; no successful result before complete file publication
prevention.strategy: Project/hash single-flight lookup validates all imported candidates (including hash directories) with size-prefiltered streaming hashes and size/mtime/ctime cache. Invalid sidecars are skipped. Publication selects an unoccupied filename and never replaces externally changed content.

legacy_paths.rationale: Existing non-upload paths remain semantically separate; no alternate upload persistence path remains for new imports.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing Node crypto and filesystem primitives own this internal persistence invariant.

migration: On-demand existing upload lookup covers legacy and hash directories, prefilters file size, streams SHA256, and atomically caches hash plus size/mtime/ctime in valid existing sidecars. Changed content and invalid sidecars remain untouched; reimports allocate another vacant filename when no valid match remains. No existing duplicates are deleted.
residual_risks: True Electron import screenshots are owned by the parent task

invariant_owner_layer.why_here: Both local bytes and native uploads converge before writing project assets
